en: This is a sepia-toned, vintage photograph postcard featuring a large and ornate neoclassical building with arched windows and decorative stonework. The building appears to be set within a garden or park, and there are leafless trees in the foreground, indicating autumn or early spring. The lower right corner has text that reads 'ZUDUSI LATVIJA', which may refer to a Latvian historical archive or project.
